dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Visible single white horizontal band across the greater coverts with high grayscale contrast against the dark wing feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence and boundary sharpness of pale edges along the folded secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, irregular white patch located on the posterior nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, distinct linear boundary separating the black crown from the olive-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible white patch on the side of the head and yellowish-green dorsal coloration.
